title: Manual Resolve
description: manual-resolve/v1: a party asking to resolve open exceptions on a trade without anything more moving on the platform, because the parties settled the matter between themselves or it no longer stands. The request is the requester's own consent; the counterparty answers it. Nothing is resolved until it is accepted, and a rejection leaves the exceptions open. The event cites every exception it answers; exceptionIds mirrors that list.

manualResolveId.description: Identity of this request, minted by the facade.

tradeId.description: The trade whose exceptions the request answers.

exceptionIds.description: The exception events the request answers, as the event cites them.

reason.description: Why resolving by hand is right: not a restatement of the finding, which the exception carries.
